notes.title: Estigma released! plus Tamashii with 40% OFF
notes.content:
Did you know ESTIGMA is Tamashii's spin-off?
Tamashii is a straightforward puzzle platform game inspired by obscure Japanese games from the 90s and late 80s, and you can get it with 40% OFF during Winter Sale (Offer ends 5 January).

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1026400/TAMASHII/
